profileLabel: Mixed economics; mixed electoral institutions (low confidence)
summary: Isabela 1st District representative (Assistant Minority Floor Leader per the input file) with 54 principal-authored bills. Reviewed evidence is co-authored tax-abolition, minimum wage and electoral bills. Recent Facebook posts were birthday greetings.
caveat: Co-authored bills only; Facebook content had no ideological signal. Minority-bloc role not verified here.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Co-authored estate-tax abolition and travel-tax abolition (market-leaning) and national minimum wage (labor-protective). Net balanced; all co-authored, no principal-authored economic bills surfaced.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB06552, HB08464, HB07443, HB08081, HB00094 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Co-authored anti-dynasty bills but also postponement of 2026 barangay elections and five-year barangay terms. Contradictory, co-author-only evidence; weak institutional-support lean.
